enrichment.headline: Creates job descriptions for a charter schools liaison and a career technical education manager
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution creating two new district job descriptions. One is a Community Liaison, Charter Schools. The other is a Program Manager, Career Technical Education. The text does not state a cost.

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (6–1), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

items.title: Creation of Job Descriptions - Community Liaison, Charter Schools and Program Manager, Career Technical Education - Talent/Human Resources Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $17,558 to Bay Area Community Resources' after-school work at Futures Elementary
enrichment.summary: This amends a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources for virtual after-school and school-day support at Futures Elementary School. The support covers academic help, enrichment, physical activity and community building. The added $17,558 raises the cap from $120,792 to $138,350 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant; After School Education and Safety (ASES) Kids Code Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Futures Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Adds $48,895 to Bay Area Community Resources' after-school contract at Life Academy
enrichment.summary: This amends a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources for after-school and school-day support at Life Academy. The support covers academic help, enrichment, physical activity and community building. The added $48,895 raises the cap from $244,786 to $293,681 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Life Academy

enrichment.headline: Adds $6,272 to Girls Inc. of Alameda County's after-school work at Acorn Woodland
enrichment.summary: This amends a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Girls Inc. of Alameda County to give more support to teachers and students at Acorn Woodland Elementary School. The work includes academic support, enrichment, physical activity and community building. The added $6,272 raises the cap from $104,997 to $111,269 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021- Girls Inc. of Alameda County - After School Program - Acorn Woodland Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Adds $29,646 to Oakland Leaf Foundation's Bret Harte contract for case management and a class
enrichment.summary: This amends a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Oakland Leaf Foundation to add school-day case management hours and a subcontractor to lead a leadership class at Bret Harte Middle School. The added $29,646 raises the cap from $180,734 to $210,380 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant, 21st Century Community Learning Centers Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Oakland Leaf Foundation - After School Program - Bret Harte Middle School

enrichment.headline: Adds $15,238 for Bay Area Community Resources staff and driver's education at Rudsdale
enrichment.summary: This amends a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Bay Area Community Resources to hire one more staff member for daytime academic support and to offer a driver's education class twice a week at Rudsdale Continuation School. The added $15,238 raises the cap from $132,785 to $148,023 for July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021.

items.fundingSource: 21st Century After School Safety and Enrichment for Teens Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - Bay Area Community Resources - After School Program - Rudsdale Continuation School

enrichment.headline: Adds $10,397 for East Bay Asian Youth Center one-to-one tutoring at Urban Promise Academy
enrichment.summary: This is the second amendment to a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with East Bay Asian Youth Center. It pays for an after-school teacher to give one-to-one academic help, four hours a day, to up to twelve newcomer or special education students at Urban Promise Academy. The added $10,397 raises the cap from $135,306 to $145,703 for August 1, 2020 through July 31, 2021.

items.fundingSource: After School Education and Safety (ASES) Grant

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 2, Memorandum of Understanding 2020-2021 - East Bay Asian Youth Center - After School Program - Urban Promise Academy

enrichment.headline: Ratifies Bunche Academy's temporary move to the former Lowell campus
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution ratifying, or formally approving after the fact, the temporary location of Bunche Academy at the former Lowell Campus. The text does not state a cost or an end date.

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote on April 28 (7–0), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

items.title: Bunche Academy - Temporary Location - Superintendent of Schools

enrichment.headline: Ratifies a new member of the Measure N College and Career Readiness Commission
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the Board President's appointment of a first-term member to the Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission. The term runs from March 26, 2021 to January 31, 2023.

pulled.summary: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–1, 1 abstaining), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

items.title: Appointment - Member, Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - President, Board of Education
